task: Create a new guardian-themed illustration in the same visual series with a different composition
reference_role: Extract palette, shape language, brushwork, texture and visual hierarchy without copying the original layout
theme: A monumental guardian shelters ordinary people threatened by war, expressing protection, solidarity and resilience

style.visual_language: Raw, forceful contemporary allegorical editorial illustration and poster design
style.palette: Highly saturated lemon yellow with cornflower and cobalt blue as the principal masses, cold gray for the environment, near-black navy for structure, and extremely small vermilion accents signaling danger
style.shapes: Exaggerated anatomy with enormous shoulders, back and arms relative to a small head; summarize facial features through a few asymmetrical angular marks
style.rendering: Broad flat color combined with dry brushing, scraping and irregular painted edges, avoiding realistic volumetric modeling
style.texture: Worn-ink mottling, vertical dragged streaks, grain and erased patches integrated into the color planes, with varied intensity rather than uniform coverage
style.linework: Bold near-black brush shapes and broken contours establish structure, while sparse white scratched lines emphasize the protected area
style.detail_hierarchy: Prioritize the protective gesture and silhouettes, restrain facial detail, and depict small people as simplified black silhouettes
style.mood: Urgent but resolute, with strength and compassion; the guardian must not appear to threaten those being protected

new_composition.guardian: A monumental blue guardian bends diagonally from the upper right toward the lower left, looking down at the people, without a crown
new_composition.gesture: One enormous forearm and open hand form a sheltering arc while the other hand braces beside the group; do not cup the people in two palms
new_composition.people: A small group of ordinary people move closely together or hold hands along a narrow ground strip in the lower image, standing on the ground rather than in a palm
new_composition.protective_mark: A few rough white arcs and short strokes indicate the sheltered area, without a complete white oval floating inside the hands
new_composition.movement: A yellow draped mass spreads diagonally, with flowing black hair or cloth marks reinforcing asymmetrical movement
new_composition.threat: Place two simplified dark missile symbols in the upper left, with tiny red-orange tips and broken white exhaust marks; keep the threat symbolic and non-graphic

avoid: A copied, mirrored or merely recolored original composition
Photorealism, smooth 3D surfaces or glossy commercial rendering
Intricate fantasy armor, metallic ornament or elaborate background buildings
Uniform grain coverage or texture that obscures the subject
Graphic wounds, gore or identifiable real political figures
Text, slogans, logos, signatures, watermarks and borders
success_criteria: Preserve the strong blue-yellow contrast, rough printed texture, monumental-versus-tiny scale relationship and clear protective meaning, while redesigning the pose, gesture and layout
